scripts.dev: node scripts/map-db-env.cjs npx prisma generate && next dev --turbopack --hostname 0.0.0.0
scripts.build: node scripts/map-db-env.cjs npx prisma generate && node scripts/map-db-env.cjs npx prisma db push --skip-generate && node scripts/map-db-env.cjs npx tsx scripts/seed-if-empty.ts && next build
scripts.db:push: node scripts/map-db-env.cjs npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/map-db-env.cjs npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/map-db-env.cjs npx prisma migrate reset --force
